Parley 0.9.0, by the Parley Authors.
https://github.com/linebender/parley
Upstream commit: 65fd4ad705deabc89b732cf7e8de9245466a2450
Distributed under Apache-2.0 OR MIT; both licenses are included.

Lince uses ICU dictionary segmentation for word and line boundaries, following
the complex-script support in Parley 0.11.1. This enables Chinese, Japanese,
Thai, Lao, Khmer and Burmese boundaries without changing the Bevy text API.
The bidirectional class mask uses named ICU properties instead of the deprecated
ICU4C numeric conversion, preserving the same class bits. The manifest omits the
upstream readme field. The dictionary integration test checks Japanese words
with per-character line breaks disabled; no other source changes apply.
